summary: Air quality in New Delhi is Very Poor (AQI 377, mainly PM2.5). Following this plan lowers the household's estimated exposure by about 67% and saves 5.08 kg CO2e of commute emissions today.

Open windows for fresh air around 12:00 - 14:00.

indoorAir.cookingAdvice: Keep the kitchen exhaust fan on while cooking and close the kitchen door so oil mist and combustion particles do not spread through the house.
indoorAir.ventilationWindow: Open windows only around 12:00 - 14:00. Open windows for fresh air around 12:00 - 14:00.
indoorAir.purifierStrategy: You have no purifier. Keep one room as a clean room: seal gaps, wet-mop instead of sweeping, and consider a HEPA purifier for the bedroom.
hazardWarnings: Incense and mosquito coils release fine particles and irritant gases indoors. Skip them on smog days, or burn them near an open window.
Avoid hard outdoor exercise in the early morning and evening, when ground-level particle levels are usually highest.

communityTip: Ask your housing society or school to stop open burning of leaves and waste, and to organise carpools for the morning run.
